name: flauz-telemetry
description: Flauz telemetry with explicit privacy controls + provider/environment failure handling: the opt-in plane (a declared event schema the operator inspects BEFORE enabling -- every recordable dimension enumerated: event kind, surface, outcome, duration-bucket, error-code, ids; NEVER contents), the collection plane (closed-vocabulary aggregate rows over the real durable surfaces -- provider lanes, environment validation, workflow steps -- swept fail-closed for secret-shaped values, persisted workspace-locally under .flauz/telemetry/ with retention pruning; no network egress in v0), the inspection plane (the local aggregate report: per-surface counts, outcome distributions, duration histograms, the error-code census), the typed provider/environment failure taxonomy (every failure mode of the prior waves' surfaces typed with its class, surface+identity, remediation hint and telemetry dimension), and the failure census (flauz.failures.list -- failures as first-class queryable state, grouped by class with remediation hints and the time distribution; every record pass banks a census-visible evidence row so the W1 diagnostics census genuinely reports the telemetry activity).

commands.title: Telemetry: Configure (Opt-in, Inspect the Declared Schema First)
Failures: Recent Failure Census (Typed, Grouped, Remediation Hints)
